app.name: ZiroEdge
app.subtitle: Private On-Device AI
app.description:
ZiroEdge brings state-of-the-art AI models directly to your iPhone and iPad — with zero data ever leaving your device.

• Chat with Gemma 4 and Llama 3.2 models, fully offline
• Every word you type and every response stays on your device — no accounts, no cloud, no tracking
• Streaming responses with markdown rendering let you read as the model thinks
• Conversation branching lets you explore alternate responses from any message
• Vision support: snap a photo or pick from your library and the model sees it (Gemma 4 E2B/E4B)
• Core Data persistence means your conversations survive cold restarts
• Intelligent memory management keeps the model loaded only when you need it

Privacy is the foundation, not an afterthought. ZiroEdge never connects to a server for inference, never collects analytics, and never asks you to create an account. The models live on your device, and your conversations stay with you — always.
app.promotionalText: Your conversations are yours alone. ZiroEdge runs AI entirely on device — no cloud, no accounts, no data collection. Download once, chat privately forever.
